title: Keep Documentation and Review as distinct application sides
preconditions: The reviewer is open on the Documentation side with feature content available.

steps.action: Read the application navigation and Documentation views.
steps.expected_result: Documentation exposes the lasting overview and feature hierarchy without review decisions or comment controls.

steps.action: Switch to Review and back using the application side controls.
steps.expected_result: Each side presents its own labeled views and the selected side remains unambiguous.

expected_result: Pass when Documentation and Review are visibly distinct and Documentation has no review controls; fail if the navigation mixes the two sides or exposes approval actions in Documentation.
